name: Half-Orc
desc: Humans with orc blood: tough, relentless and quick to throw themselves into a fight.

traits.name: Orcish Darkvision
traits.desc: You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

traits.name: Adrenaline Rush
traits.desc: You can take the Dash action as a Bonus Action. When you do so, you gain Temporary Hit Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus. You can use this trait a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

traits.name: Orcish Resilience
traits.desc: When you would be reduced to 0 Hit Points but not killed outright, you can drop to 1 Hit Point instead. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a Long Rest.
